o1:
Enables microtubule binding activity; phosphatidylinositol phosphate binding activity; and protein kinase binding activity.  
Involved in cell polarity; asymmetric cell division; asymmetric protein localization involved in cell fate determination; and establishment of mitotic spindle orientation. Predicted to be involved in the establishment or maintenance of cell polarity.  
Is located in P granule; posterior cell cortex; and cell cortex. Is part of protein-containing complex.  
Is expressed in EMS; P0; Psub1; Psub2; and germ line.  
Is part of the PAR polarity pathway.
